translation.name: Biblica® Wonhia ɛho kwamma nhoma Akuapem Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content: Bio, mehwɛ mihuu nhyɛso a ɛrekɔ so wɔ owia yi ase:

content.text: Mihuu wɔn a wɔredi wɔn nya no nusu
tumi no wɔ wɔn nhyɛsofo no nsam
wɔn a wɔda so wɔ nkwa mu no.
Na nea oye sen baanu yi

content: Na mihuu sɛ adwumayɛ mu ɔbrɛ ne nea onipa tumi yɛ nyinaa nnyinaso ne sɛ nʼani bere ne yɔnko. Eyi nso yɛ ahuhude, mmirika a wotu taa mframa.

content.text: Ɔkwasea bobɔw ne nsa gu ne ho
Nsammua baako a asomdwoe wɔ mu
ye sen nsammua abien a ɔbrɛ bata ho;

content: Afei nso mihuu biribi a ɛnka hwee wɔ owia yi ase:

content.text: Na ɔbarima bi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ ankonam;
Obisaa ne ho se, “Na hena na merebrɛ ama no,
na adɛn nti na mede anigye kame me kra?”
efisɛ wonya wɔn brɛ so mfaso a ɛsɔ ani:
Nanso onipa a ɔhwe ase a
Bio, sɛ baanu da bɔ mu a wɔka wɔn ho hyew.
Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ankonam bɛka ne ho hyew?
Ɔbaakofo de, wobetumi aka no ahyɛ
nanso baanu tumi pere wɔn ti.
Hama a wɔawɔ no mmɛsa no, wontumi ntetew mu ntɛm.

content: Ɔbabun nyansafo a odi hia ye sen ɔhene akwakoraa a ɔyɛ ɔkwasea na ontie kɔkɔbɔ bio.
Ebia na ɔbabun no fi afiase na obedii ade anaasɛ wɔwoo no too ohia mu wɔ adehye abusua mu.
Mihuu sɛ wɔn a wɔtenaa ase na wɔnantew owia yi ase nyinaa dii ɔbabun no akyi, nea odii ɔhene no ade no.
Nnipadɔm a wontumi nkan wɔn dii nʼakyi. Nanso nkyirimma no ani annye ne ho. Eyi nso yɛ ahuhude, ɛte sɛ wotaa mframa.
